title: 5 Star Day in the Granada Mountains
text:
We had an amazing day with Julio.  He was very punctual, knowledgable  and friendly. We had a group of 8 and he modified the trip so that everyone, young and older, enjoyed themselves.  He even took beautiful photos for us.  We will remember this day and the experience of the Sierra Nevadas for years to come.

author: Shoolihan

title: Wonderful snow tour with exuberant views of Sierra Nevada.
text: Wonderful tour with Guia Júlio, very requested, led us very satisfactorily, with a lot of safety and accurate information on the track with the rackets on the snow.
author: Quest31664374856

title: Great escape from the city!
text: This is a half day trip into the Sierra Nevada from Granada. Julio is an excellent guide and clear about what we needed to bring and where to meet. The walk location was beautiful. and the walk intensity was light for me but could see it being moderate for people. This is a great addition to a visit to Granada!!
author: Jamie_K

title: All about the views
text: Julio was an excellent guide.  The route allowed us to enjoy some wonderful views and was strenuous enough  (2 hours moderate hiking with snow shoes), without being too challenging.  I appreciated his careful driving on the way to and from the mountains from Granada.
author: Sightseer760878

title: Excellent snowshoe trip!
text:
This day excursion is incredible! My 12 year old son and I went on it together, and we both had a blast. Julio is professional, punctual and kind. We met in the designated square for the pick-up and drove up the mountain in his clean, comfortable van.
When you arrive at the top, you’ll get your snowshoes and poles and an explanation on how to use them. It’s easy! Wear boots if possible because they seemed to fit more comfortably with the snowshoes (versus low shoes). The length of the walk is perfect - not too short and not too long. It’s just enough of trek to feel adventurous, but not stress
author: kellysY876RZ

title: Nice experience with an amazing tour guide
text: We enjoyed the trip very much and special thanks to Mr. Julio who was very nice and hospitable. Totally recommend.
author: Moustafa_E

title: Siërra Nevada snowshoe walk in small group
text:
Snowshoe walk in the Siërra Nevada: Julio is very friendly and comunicative. Hè contacted us himself 2 days before the planned date, because there was no snow. He gave us several options; a snowshoe walk higher in the mountains, a hike without snow, postponing of cancelling. As we stayed for a week in the area, we decided to postpone, and had a wonderfull snowshoe experience with 3 other participants, a few days later. Julio provided us us with water and a snack, information about the area and animals and took plenty of photographs and video, which he sent to us afterwards.

title: Snow Hiking in Sierra Nevada - Fantastic
text:
Absolutely 100% recommend. Great value for money. Julio is a fantastic guide and provided all the equipment (snow shoes/poles) water/snack. Drove us to the starting point (2500m), about 45 mins  from meeting point in Granada.
Hike was about 2 and a bit hours and went up to about 2750m. Julio points out a lot of interesting things relating to the local climate and terrain, in addition to making professional photos. 
I would say you need a level of moderate fitness and a mind set of JUST DO IT. 
I took my hiking mad 18 year old son and he loved it too, so fully endorsed for both generations. 5 S
author: ringo175

title: A fantastic trip up in the snowy peaks and a novel way to look back towards Granada
text: A fantastic trip up in the snowy peaks and a novel way to look back towards Granada. Our host, Julio, welcomed us and carefully drove up the spectacular pass to the hiking spot. The equipment was in great condition and easy to use. In a mix of Spanish, Portuguese and English, Julio pointed out places of interest and facts about the area. The level of effort required is moderate and you are well-rewarded for it.
author: Johnathan_M

title: Snow shoe hiking with julio
text: Our guide Julio was very friendly and experienced! Highly recommended trip! Great for beginners looking for an easy hike
